description: Source file providing formatting utilities for currency, percent, trend indicators, and compact number formatting used across the application.

methods.name: formatCurrency( value, { currency = "USD", locale = undefined,  minimumFractionDigits = 2, maximumFractionDigits = 2 } = {} )
methods.description: Formats a number as currency string, with options for currency code, locale, and fractional digits.

methods.name: formatPercent( value, { locale = undefined, minimumFractionDigits = 2, maximumFractionDigits = 2, inputIsFraction = true  } = {} )
methods.description: Formats a number as a percentage string, optionally treating input as a fraction or an already percentage.

methods.name: formatTrend( value, { decimals = 1, showSign = false, suffix = "%" } = {} )
methods.description: Provides trend formatting with arrow icons, signs, and labels for UI indicators.

methods.name: formatCompactNumber( value, { locale = undefined, minimumFractionDigits = 0, maximumFractionDigits = 1 } = {} )
methods.description: Formats a number in a compact form (e.g., 1.2K, 3.4M) with locale support.
